changelog:
ETF Growth v9.0 — MAJOR: a rules-based, point-in-time fund pool and a volatility budget on the book's true volatility.\n\n1. Rules-based, point-in-time pool: 22 dated pools ("Rule pool v5 (C12) — as-of 2004…2025"), each applied from the January after it was built, read through dynamic_menu.pool_schedule. Funds are grouped by holdings containment under declared sector, size/style and world roots; a narrow fund is seated only if distinct from the seats already there in holdings and in tracking error; the cheapest scorable fund takes a seat. Declaration data/exposures/arms/dt-C12.json; pool constitution v5 + R19 + R20 (docs/engineering/pool-constitution.md).\n2. Two data-driven fund rules, re-measured each January: R19 levered market — refused when monthly beta to VTI over 36 months ≥ 1.3 AND holdings sector drift ≥ 0.15 (today SPHB); R20 composition stability — refused when the seat's own 12-month holdings overlap < 0.453 (today MTUM, SPMO, XMMO, XSMO).\n3. Declared broad seats exempt from the tail screen (dynamic_menu.tail_exempt_symbols); they still face the dedup.\n4. Gold rated on its own scale and sized by equal risk (v8.symbol_ratings, v8.trend_seats vol_scale, EWMA vol).\n5. Strength cap (v8.harvest_cap 0.40): the harvest objective pays min(strength, 0.40) — forward returns flatten above that level.\n6. True book volatility (joint_constraints.vol_budget, mode "portfolio", bound 1.8): √(wᵀΣw) ≤ 1.8 × SPY's volatility, replacing the sum of own volatilities; solved exactly by cutting planes on a shrunk 60-day correlation.\n7. World active-risk row (vol_budget.active): σ(book − world) ≤ 1.05 × SPY's volatility (the 75th percentile of the book's own active risk, by rule); world = VTI 0.564 / EFA 0.353 / EEM 0.083, fitted to ACWI.\n8. Rebound-boost refutation needs two consecutive closes below the 40-day average (rebound_boost.refute_confirm_closes 1).\n9. Engine: each option default-off and byte-exact absent (diff:engine: every shared scenario identical).\n\nMeasured (first-of-month path, 2006 → 2026-10-23, vs v8.0.1): CAGR 21.26% vs 19.02%, Martin 4.164 vs 2.977. Panel (offsets {1,6,11,16} + cadence): centre 19.84% vs 18.63% (+1.21pp); stress gate passes on all four arms; off-path Martin +0.61, worst-12mo +0.44pp, worst-3m +0.18pp; absolute floors every arm (maxDD worst −19.8%, worst-12mo worst −13.4%); cadence panel passes every band. Years behind SPY 4 (v8: 5). Walk §8.418–§8.428.\n\nD6 acknowledged: Devon 2026-10-29: cohorts behind regresses +0.57pp off-path (+0.25pp first-of-month). It is the end-dated share of start dates still behind SPY at 2026-10-23, dominated by 2026 starts — v8's 2026 semiconductor run (34.8% vs 28.7%). Every other D6 measure improves: RDD3y −2.21pp, longest underwater −1,305 days, long-bull trailing windows −6.88pp, calendar years behind SPY 5 → 4.\n\nDisclosures: the pool rules were developed and revised against 2006–2025, so the credentials are in-sample for those choices; fund definitions read 2026 holdings; the fund list is survivors only; the bond sleeve is unchanged (hand-picked).

[major: Two new methodologies: the offensive fund pool is built by mechanical rules point-in-time (22 dated pools rebuilt each January, data-driven fund rules) instead of a hand-curated list; and the allocation's volatility budget constrains the book's TRUE volatility (and its active risk vs a world index) by an exact cutting-plane solve instead of a sum of own volatilities. Devon 2026-10-29: 'Let's run a MAJOR cut on both Growth and Preserve.']

Decision-date ensemble (reallocation.decision_ensemble): the traded book blends WHICH risk names are held across the last 10 decision days (exponential, halflife 3; the freshest day ~23%), posture and defensive legs always the freshest read's, reconcentrated to the fresh book's name count. A shock reset drops every older day after a break: SPY's 21-day fall from high beyond the point-in-time 90th percentile of such falls. Fixes the execution-date knife-edge (N=11 trailed 2.1pp/yr, 77% from name selection): centre CAGR 20.08 -> 21.14% (+1.05pp), every cadence phase +1.07 to +1.98pp, month-offset dispersion -0.58pp, off-path Martin +0.40, worst-12mo +0.48pp. Re-cut of the unprinted v9.0 (Devon 2026-10-30): a restatement of v9.0, not a new version.
